comments.author: Caveman
comments.content:
Thank you for all your hard work! I love Quest! However, I only play choose-your-own-adventure type textadventures and don't like the other ones where you have to type. That's why I wanted to ask you, if you would create a "cyoa"-category at http://textadventures.co.uk/ so people like me don't have to spend forever looking for this kind of game on the site.
Best regards.
